description: Regression labels for the 40 rows inspected in the read-only AliExpress OCR identity audit plus all rows promoted from the unseen 2024-12-17 and 2024-12-20 days. This file is not a holdout after a row is opened for diagnosis.

evidence.gold_policy: Only identities established by captured source rows plus catalog, image, variant, or position evidence are labelled catalog_match. Private invoice quantities and monetary values remain in ignored local evidence. Unresolved catalog duplication stays ambiguous, and operational supplies with no catalog product stay no_exists.
